Message:
drm/amdgpu: fix pplib finish bug

1,should use late_fini to kfree all resource otherwise
the released pointer maybe accessed in IRQ ip fini routine.

2,hwmgr should not be kfree by pem_fini which is invoked
by hw fini path.
